disclaimer: Every person below is fictional. Names, jobs, circumstances, and quotes are invented for simulation input. They do not describe customers, prospects, or real couples. No real personal data, credentials, media, or location is included.

couples.summary: Two years together, different cities, both on iPhone, sees each other monthly.
Eight years together, one Android and one iPhone, low app engagement.
Five months together, both Android, high engagement and strict privacy expectations.
Twelve years together, mixed platforms, one member has low vision and uses large text.
Three years together, both Android, unreliable rural connectivity and little free storage.
Four years together, mixed platforms, one member opens the app weekly at most.
Ten years together, both iPhone, both wary of cloud copies and account recovery.
Forty years together, mixed platforms, tremor and hearing accessibility needs.
One year together, both Android, storage pressure and no appetite for subscriptions.
Three years together, both frontend engineers, one iPhone and one Android; they inspect states, spacing and recovery paths.
Five years together, staff frontend and design-systems engineers, mixed platforms; they audit navigation, motion and accessibility.
Seven years together, a product critic and a UX auditor, mixed platforms; they deliberately take the wrong path and expect the interface to explain itself.
One year together, a design critic and a skeptical engineer, mixed platforms; they test visual hierarchy, offline states and whether status claims are true.
